messages:
alex_ae: Hey team — Zenara SIG v3 just landed. They flagged ~10 Qs but priority is Q5.1 (network segmentation) and Q7.3 (KMS key rotation). Deadline Friday EOD. Can SE/security advise what artifacts we can provide from our side vs ask them to supply? cc @maya_se @linh_infosec

maya_se: I can assemble a stack-level artifact pack. For Q5.1 we typically include: a short network diagram (PNG), VPC/subnet table export, and a snippet of the infra-as-code showing security group rules. For Q7.3: KMS key rotation policy + key metadata (creation/rotation dates).

linh_infosec: Acceptance criteria from vendor team: artifacts need to show proof of control + how it is enforced. Screenshots are OK if they include timestamps and the path in console. Prefer logs or exported JSON where possible. All PII masked. For KMS we need a key policy snippet and rotation schedule — a screenshot alone may be insufficient unless accompanied by exported metadata.

alex_ae: Good — can you paste the exact minimal list I should request from Zenara so I can email them? I want to avoid back-and-forth.

maya_se: Minimal ask to customer (copy-paste):
- Network diagram showing VPCs and peering (PNG/PDF)
- Export of subnet table and security group rules (CSV/JSON)
- Console screenshot of the VPC peering resource with timestamp (if you cannot export)
- KMS key metadata export (JSON) showing rotationEnabled/lastRotated
- Key policy text (redact any customer-only identifiers)

If they can't export JSON, ask for CLI output they can copy: `aws kms describe-key --key-id <id>` or equivalent.

cory_salesops: Upload & naming: put everything in the secured evidence bucket under s3://redwood-sec-evidence/sales/zenara/SIG_v3/ and follow filename pattern Q{number}_{artifact}_{source}.{ext}. Add a Google sheet row with: artifact, filename, uploader, source (customer / redwood), redaction notes. I'll create the sheet and share.

linh_infosec: Also add a short attestation from the person who uploaded stating they verified redaction and that the artifact is accurate. Template: "I confirm this artifact truthfully represents the resource state on <date> and all required redactions were applied."

alex_ae: Perfect. I'll send to Zenara now. Quick question — is a masked console screenshot of the KMS key showing rotation toggle enough if they can't run CLI?

linh_infosec: It can be acceptable as a short-term measure but we should mark it as "screenshot-only" in the sheet. If they sign the attestation and we have the key creation date from billing/metadata it should pass. For long-term customers ask for JSON export.

maya_se: If Zenara needs examples, I'll drop two redacted samples in the evidence bucket: sample_Q5_1_vpc.png and sample_Q7_3_kms.json.

alex_ae: Awesome — ETA from me is EOD tomorrow for their initial drop. I'll post the evidence links here when they upload. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

[evidence-bot]: Automated note: evidence-bot will scan s3://redwood-sec-evidence/sales/zenara/SIG_v3/ hourly and post missing-metadata warnings to this thread.

cory_salesops: Added sheet and permissions — link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ExampleSharedSheet (internal). Make sure to set owner to cory_salesops before final handoff.

alex_ae: Sending message to customer now — will follow up with a thread update when they reply.

maya_se: If they push back on CLI steps we can offer a short screen-share tomorrow to help them export. Saves time.

linh_infosec: Thanks team — once artifacts are in place I'll do a quick QA pass and mark each Q as "evidence accepted" or "needs follow-up" in the sheet.

alex_ae: Thanks everyone, closing loop for now.
